switchPolicy: Same process and persistent corpus index; new scope per request; no reindexing on selection change. Reset answer context or enforce scope on all history.
rules: All six documents indexed before querying; selection filters applied before context assembly.
Retriever receives queries and corpus only, never review-key.
Physical PDF pages are one-based; unknown pages stay null and cannot pass exact-evidence checks.
Same supported embedding/answer models and budgets across arms; record all differences.
No claims of answer correctness from citation presence, token matching or model self-ratings.
Record every failure and abstention. Report OCR adjunct separately.
Do not merge proposed questions with frozen M5/M6 scores.
Pin exact software/model revisions and cache roots before execution.
scopeMode: Explicit selected-only mode; broader search remains the product default.
answerAssessmentStatus: assistant assessment against human-approved references; generated answers not human-reviewed
measuredRunDeviations: Zotero baseline indexes five papers; q10/q11 have no baseline text and remain unavailable.
Identifier-only fixture metadata is used in both arms.
Answer passes were serialized; timings are diagnostic, not controlled performance measurements.
Page references are preserved in disposable comparison storage; production parser activation is not included.
